entries.title: ΗΠΑ: Πρότυπα συμμαχίας και μήνυμα προς Νότια Κορέα
entries.paragraph_1: Τα «πρότυπα συμμαχίας» τίθενται πλέον ρητά από την Ουάσιγκτον προς τη Σεούλ, με έμφαση στην ανταλλαγή πληροφοριών και την αντικατασκοπία. Η αμερικανική προειδοποίηση έρχεται σε φάση ορατών τριγμών στη συνεργασία, από τις μυστικές υπηρεσίες έως τις κοινές στρατιωτικές ασκήσεις. Τα «πρότυπα συμμαχίας» τίθενται πλέον ρητά από την Ουάσιγκτον προς τη Σεούλ, με έμφαση στην ανταλλαγή πληροφοριών και την αντικατασκοπία. Η τοποθέτηση ανώτερου Αμερικανού αξιωματούχου καταγράφει θεσμικά την ανησυχία για την κατάσταση της διμερούς συνεργασίας, την ώρα που οι τριβές γίνονται δημόσιες. Πώς τα πρότυπα συμμαχίας γίνονται εργαλείο πίεσης προς τη Σεούλ; Η αμερικανική απαίτηση να «τηρηθούν τα πρότυπα» στον τομέα των μυστικών υπηρεσιών λειτουργεί ως σαφές μήνυμα πολιτικού ελέγχου προς την κυβέρνηση της Νότιας Κορέας. Όταν η Ουάσιγκτον επιλέγει να μιλήσει δημοσίως για πληροφορίες και αντικατασκοπία, δείχνει ότι θεωρεί κρίσιμη τη θεσμική πειθαρχία του συμμάχου σε ζητήματα εμπιστευτικότητας. Το πλαίσιο αυτό βαραίνει περισσότερο μετά τις πληροφορίες ότι ο Αμερικανός υπουργός Εμπορίου Χάουαρντ Λάτνικ φέρεται να εξέφρασε δυσαρέσκεια για τη νοτιοκορεατική υπηρεσία πληροφοριών, κάτι που η Σεούλ επισήμως διαψεύδει. Ακόμη και αν η κυβέρνηση της Νότιας Κορέας απορρίπτει τις αιτιάσεις, η ίδια η συζήτηση δείχνει ρωγμές στην αμοιβαία εμπιστοσύνη, εκεί όπου παραδοσιακά η σιωπή θεωρείται βασική προϋπόθεση συνεργασίας. Πώς επηρεάζουν οι τριβές την ασφάλεια στην Ανατολική Ασία; Η πληροφορία ότι η Νότια Κορέα φέρεται να αποκλείστηκε από τριμερή συνάντηση ΗΠΑ–Ιαπωνίας, κατόπιν αμερικανικού αιτήματος, συνιστά πολιτικό μήνυμα επανατοποθέτησης ρόλων στο περιφερειακό σχήμα ασφαλείας. Ακόμη κι αν δεν επιβεβαιώνεται επισήμως, η εικόνα μιας «επιλεκτικής τριμερούς» ενισχύει την εντύπωση ότι η Σεούλ αξιολογείται πιο αυστηρά από την Ουάσιγκτον. Παράλληλα, η απόφαση του προέδρου Ντόναλντ Τραμπ να περιορίσει τις κοινές στρατιωτικές ασκήσεις με τη Νότια Κορέα, με το επιχείρημα ότι στέλνουν «εχθρικό» μήνυμα προς τη Βόρεια Κορέα, αλλάζει το επιχειρησιακό στίγμα της αποτροπής στην περιοχή. Η μείωση των ασκήσεων μπορεί να εκληφθεί από την Πιονγιάνγκ ως χαλάρωση πίεσης, ενώ για τη Σεούλ δημιουργεί την αίσθηση ότι ο βασικός σύμμαχος επαναπροσδιορίζει το κόστος και το όφελος της στρατιωτικής του παρουσίας. Τι σημαίνει για την Ελλάδα Για την Ελλάδα, η συζήτηση περί «προτύπων συμμαχίας» σε μια τόσο κρίσιμη διμερή σχέση λειτουργεί ως υπενθύμιση ότι η θεσμική αξιοπιστία σε θέματα πληροφοριών και άμυνας αποτελεί σκληρό κριτήριο για όλες τις χώρες–συμμάχους των ΗΠΑ. Η Αθήνα παρακολουθεί τέτοιες εξελίξεις γνωρίζοντας ότι η διαφάνεια, η συνέπεια και η σταθερότητα στις δεσμεύσεις της στο ΝΑΤΟ επηρεάζουν άμεσα το διπλωματικό της κεφάλαιο. Σχόλιο : Η αμερικανοκορεατική ένταση γύρω από πληροφορίες, ασκήσεις και περιφερειακές συναντήσεις δείχνει ότι οι ΗΠΑ δεν διστάζουν να χρησιμοποιήσουν τα εργαλεία της ασφάλειας ως μοχλό πολιτικής πίεσης. Για την Ελλάδα, που επενδύει σε αναβαθμισμένο ρόλο εντός της συμμαχίας, το μήνυμα είναι σαφές: η αξιοπιστία δεν είναι ρητορική έννοια, αλλά διαρκής δοκιμασία σε πεδίο άμυνας και πληροφοριών. Διαβάστε επίσης: Ρωσία προειδοποιεί Τραμπ ότι η διπλωματική οδός για Ιράν παραμένει ανοικτή ΗΠΑ: Ο Ρούμπιο ανακοινώνει βοήθεια προς τον Παναμά μετά τον σεισμό #ΗνωμένεςΠολιτείες #ΝότιαΚορέα #ΝτόναλντΤραμπ #Μυστικέςυπηρεσίες #Στρατιωτικέςασκήσεις

entries.paragraph_1: SEOUL, Oct 12 (Reuters) - North Korea fired multiple ballistic missiles toward the sea off its east coast on Monday, South Koreaâs military said, marking Pyongyangâs fourth launch in a month and following Seoulâs recent test of a hypersonic missile.
entries.paragraph_2: By Heejin Kim and Joyce Lee The ballistic missiles, whichappeared to be of different types, were fired at around 9:20 a.m. local time (0020 GMT) from near Pyongyang, and one type flew more than 900 km (559 miles), South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff said. Earlier, Japan's coast guard said North Korea had fired two unidentified projectiles, believed to be ballistic missiles, adding that both appeared to have already fallen. South Korea's National Security Office convened an emergency meeting, where it condemned the missile launches as violations of United Nations Security Council resolutions and urged an immediate stop. North Korea has been under UN sanctions since 2006, aimed at halting Pyongyang's development of nuclear weapons and ballistic missiles. The latest launches come at a time when tensions have been rising between the two Koreas in recent weeks amid weapons tests by both countries. Last week, South Korean President Lee Jae Myung oversaw the country's first test-firing of a hypersonic missile , a rare public showcasing of a missile test by a South Korean president. Monday's missile launches by North Korea appeared to be "a show of force in response to the successful test launch of our hypersonic missile, as well as an intentional demonstration of missile capabilities," a spokesperson for South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff said. North Korea last fired a ballistic missile on October 3 , with state media KCNA saying it was a hypersonic missile tested under the supervision of leader Kim Jong Un . The tests followed a border mine blast last month that wounded three South Korean soldiers. Seoul said the landmines had been planted by North Korea and demanded an apology, but Pyongyang has dismissed this and accused South Korea of provocation. Pyongyang has conducted missile tests on more than 10 occasions this year, including four in the last month. The unusually frequent tests indicate Pyongyang wanted to increase its leverage ahead of a potential summit between leader Kim and US President Donald Trump, said Song Seong-jong, a professor at Daejeon University in Seoul and a former South Korean Defence Ministry official. "They definitely need to raise the value of their status before meeting Trump," Song said. (Reporting by Heejin Kim and Joyce Lee in Seoul, Anton Bridge in TokyoEditing by Ed Davies)

entries.title: Νότια Κορέα Βόρεια Κορέα σε νέα διπλωματική σύγκρουση
entries.paragraph_1: Νότια Κορέα Βόρεια Κορέα βρίσκονται ξανά σε τροχιά έντασης, μετά την επίσημη καταγγελία της Σεούλ στον ΟΗΕ για σκόπιμη τοποθέτηση ναρκοπεδίου από τις βορειοκορεατικές δυνάμεις. Το περιστατικό, που τραυμάτισε τρεις στρατιώτες νότια της Στρατιωτικής Γραμμής Οριοθέτησης, επαναφέρει στο προσκήνιο τα όρια και τις αντοχές της ανακωχής στην κορεατική χερσόνησο. Νότια Κορέα Βόρεια Κορέα έφεραν εκ νέου την κορεατική χερσόνησο στο επίκεντρο της διεθνούς ανησυχίας, μετά την επίσημη παρέμβαση της Σεούλ στον ΟΗΕ για την έκρηξη νάρκης νότια της Στρατιωτικής Γραμμής Οριοθέτησης. Ο πρεσβευτής της Νότιας Κορέας Cha Ji-hoon κάλεσε τη Βόρεια Κορέα να σταματήσει τις «ενέργειες κλιμάκωσης» και να αναλάβει «υπεύθυνα μέτρα», ενώ η Πιονγκγιάνγκ απορρίπτει κατηγορηματικά τις κατηγορίες. Πώς εξελίσσεται η αντιπαράθεση Νότια Κορέα Βόρεια Κορέα στον ΟΗΕ; Η Σεούλ κατέληξε στο συμπέρασμα ότι βορειοκορεατικές δυνάμεις τοποθέτησαν σκόπιμα τη νάρκη που τραυμάτισε τρεις στρατιώτες νότια της γραμμής οριοθέτησης, προσδίδοντας στο επεισόδιο βαρύ διπλωματικό φορτίο. Ο Νοτιοκορεάτης πρεσβευτής ζήτησε από τη Βόρεια Κορέα «συγγνώμη» και τερματισμό των ενεργειών που, όπως υποστηρίζει, υπονομεύουν την ασφάλεια και τη σταθερότητα στην περιοχή. Από την άλλη πλευρά, ο πρεσβευτής της Βόρειας Κορέας στον ΟΗΕ χαρακτήρισε τις κατηγορίες «φτωχό τέχνασμα» της νοτιοκορεατικής στρατιωτικής ηγεσίας για να «μεταφέρει τη δική της ευθύνη» στην Πιονγκγιάνγκ. Η ανταλλαγή κατηγοριών στο υψηλότερο πολυμερές φόρουμ καταδεικνύει ότι η αντιπαράθεση δεν περιορίζεται στο πεδίο ασφαλείας, αλλά επεκτείνεται και στο πεδίο της διεθνούς νομιμοποίησης. Τι σημαίνει η φερόμενη παραβίαση της ανακωχής για την ασφάλεια; Η Διοίκηση του ΟΗΕ, η οποία επιβλέπει την εφαρμογή της ανακωχής στην κορεατική χερσόνησο, δήλωσε ότι το περιστατικό με τη νάρκη συνιστά παραβίαση της συμφωνίας κατάπαυσης του πυρός. Μια τέτοια διαπίστωση ενισχύει τη θέση της Νότιας Κορέας, ότι δεν πρόκειται για μεμονωμένο στρατιωτικό συμβάν, αλλά για ενέργεια με σαφείς θεσμικές και νομικές προεκτάσεις. South Korea Ambassador to Kyiv Recalled Over Prisoner Transfer Dispute   â NaturalNews.com
entries.paragraph_1: Ukraine's Foreign Ministry said it remains open to resuming constructive dialogue despite the recall. The dispute stems from Ukraine's public revelation of the transfer of two North Korean soldiers captured while fighting for Russia, according to the statements. Background of the Diplomatic Row Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky confirmed the transfer on Sept. 23, 2026, saying it was "not easy to capture alive" the two soldiers [1][2]. South Korean officials said the confidentiality arrangement was made because they were concerned about the safety of the North Korean soldiers and their relatives in the North, according to the ministry's account. The differing accounts have hardened into a public standoff between two governments that had otherwise maintained cooperative relations. The dispute marks a rare rupture between Seoul and a partner that has received sustained South Korean humanitarian support. The decision to recall an ambassador represents a severe diplomatic expression of discontent, a step Seoul had signaled it was considering for days before following through [3]. South Korea said it hopes all outstanding issues between the two countries will be resolved amicably and will continue consultations with the Ukrainian side, according to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs [4][5]. Details of the Prisoner Transfer The soldiers were captured by Ukrainian forces in Russia's Kursk region in January 2025 and have expressed their desire to resettle in South Korea because they could face persecution if repatriated to North Korea, officials said [1][6]. The repatriation was presented by Seoul as a humanitarian matter, and officials said the confidentiality arrangement was intended to protect the soldiers and their relatives. The episode sits inside a broader militarized relationship between Pyongyang and Moscow. North Korea has deepened its support for Russia's war effort, and U.S. officials previously confirmed the presence of North Korean troops on Russian territory [7]. Reports have also described North Korean leader Kim Jong Un pledging "invariable support" for what he called Vladimir Putin's "sacred war" [8]. The two captured soldiers are a visible byproduct of that alignment, and their destination became a point of public contention between Kyiv and Seoul. Reactions and Humanitarian Assistance The remark signaled that Kyiv wants to keep the dispute from widening into a broader break, even as Seoul proceeded with the recall. The figures underscore the stakes for Kyiv, which has relied on Seoul for nonlethal support, while also highlighting that Seoul has drawn a line in this dispute without indicating it intends to halt assistance. The result is a diplomatic confrontation that remains open-ended, with public positions hardening even as both governments leave the door open to further talks. Next Steps and Outlook Further developments depend on consultations between the two governments, according to the statements. For now, the recall stands as the clearest sign that a dispute over a prisoner handoff has become a test of how two partners manage a public breach. entries.paragraph_1: South Korea gained independence in 1945 after being subjected to Japanese colonial rule for 35 years. Its first independent republican government was established in 1948. North Korean leader Kim Il-sung’s invasion of the South, which was spearheaded by Soviet-made tanks, took place in 1950. Millions of people died during the following three years. This was, in essence, an unforgivable atrocity in which brother fought against brother. The consequences of the war and the division of the Korean Peninsula were profound and enduring. Koreans who had collaborated with the Japanese Empire began to once again exert their power under the banner of eradicating communism. They went after pro-democracy activists, who were against dictatorship, branding them as “commies.” In the North, members of the Workers’ Party of South Korea were executed after being accused of being US spies. The North then became a hereditary dictatorship — the Kim dynasty began after being founded by Kim Il-sung, succeeded by his son, Kim Jong-il, and is now led by Kim Jong-un. Nonetheless, South Korean presidents understood that, one day, reunification should take place.
entries.paragraph_2: Efforts for reunification are exemplified by the July 4 South-North Joint Communiqué in 1972 and the first inter-Korean reunion of separated families in 1985. While Roh Tae-woo was president, South Korea established diplomatic relations with China and the Soviet Union, and both Koreas simultaneously joined the UN. Later, President Kim Young-sam agreed to participate in an inter-Korean bilateral summit, but that fell through after Kim Il-sung’s death. Presidents Kim Dae-jung and Roh Moo-hyun did participate in bilateral summits with the North, along with Moon Jae-in, who also arranged a summit between the North and the US. Summit-level diplomacy between Pyongyang and Washington broke down in 2019 in Hanoi, after which North Korea accelerated its efforts to develop nuclear weapons and missiles. During that time, the rift between the two Koreas only widened. As South Korean culture started trickling into the North, Kim Jong-un came to view it as a threat to the regime’s long-term survival and began implementing defensive measures. After revising the North’s constitution, Kim declared that the two Koreas share the relations of two hostile countries and began fortifying the border with the South along the Military Demarcation Line (MDL), the land border around which the Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) was formed. Based on its interpretation of where the MDL stands, North Korea has been planting mines north of the line and erecting barbed-wire fences along the border. We cannot begrudge North Korea for placing mines and barbed-wire fences on its own land. However, on Sept. 21, three South Korean military officials were injured after mines planted by North Korea in the western DMZ exploded. Why did this happen? Under the 1953 Armistice Agreement, the MDL was marked by hundreds of stakes set 200 to 300 meters apart from one another. entries.paragraph_1: 중국 휴머노이드 판매 상위 10개 기업 중 8곳이 한국에서 인증·상표·판매처를 1개 이상 확보한 것으로 나타났다. 초기 단계인 국내 휴머노이드 시장에서 중국 업체들이 제품 인증과 브랜드 권리, 유통망을 선제적으로 확보하려는 움직임이 빨라졌다. 12일 산업 분석 보고서 '랩스딥리포트'에 따르면 중국 주요 휴머노이드 로봇 기업이 국내에서 KC 전파인증과 상표권, 판매 채널을 잇따라 확보하며 한국 시장 진입을 타진하고 있다. 세계 시장 출하 기준 상위권 기업은 이미 제품 인증까지 마쳤다. 애지봇은 지난 4월 중국 본사 명의로 휴머노이드 'X2 울트라'의 KC 인증받은 뒤 열흘 만에 한국 기업 아이엘과 독점 파트너 계약을 체결했다. 애지봇은 올해 상반기 세계 휴머노이드 출하 1위를 기록한 회사다. 유니트리는 지난해 12월 휴머노이드 'G1'을 본사 명의로 인증받았다. 부스터로보틱스도 소형 휴머노이드 'T1'과 'K1'의 KC 인증을 각각 2025년 1월과 올해 4월 완료했다. 국내 수입사 대신 중국 본사 명의로 직접 인증을 받는 건 한국 시장을 직접 수출 대상으로 관리하는 행보로 풀이된다.
entries.paragraph_2: 본체 인증 전 단계에서 상표와 판매망을 먼저 확보하는 시도도 늘고 있다. 갤봇은 코스닥 상장사 트윔을 한국 공식 대리점으로 두고 휠형 휴머노이드 'G1'과 산업용 'S1'을 국내 전시회에서 공개했다. 트윔은 G1에 자체 로봇 관제 플랫폼을 적용, 국내 고객사 대상 개념검증(PoC)을 하고 있다. 갤봇은 로봇 두뇌·운영체제 브랜드 '아스트라' 계열 상표 8건을 국내에 출원했고, 최근에는 한국 사업을 총괄하는 책임자도 선임했다. 유비테크는 국내 총판을 확보한 데 이어 휴머노이드 브랜드 'WALKER' 상표 등록 절차를 밟았다. 로케 역시 국내 기업 명의로 출원된 'ROKAE' 상표의 지정상품에 휴머노이드를 포함했다. 유비테크 '워커 S2', 갤봇 'G1' 등 공장·물류 현장을 겨냥한 대형 휴머노이드는 아직 KC 인증 전이지만 상표 출원과 총판 확보, 전시·PoC 등 사전 영업 활동은 이미 진행 중이다. 중국 기업의 국내 진출은 현재 대규모 판매 확대 단계라기보다 시장 진입에 필요한 인증과 브랜드 권리, 유통 기반을 선제적으로 확보하는 과정으로 볼 수 있다. 휴머노이드 완제품뿐 아니라 로봇 두뇌·운영체제 상표까지 먼저 출원하면서 향후 국내 시장 개화에 대비하려는 것으로 분석된다. 시장 진입 준비를 제품·소프트웨어·판매망 전반에서 동시다발적으로 추진하는 셈이다. 유효정 랩스딥 대표는 “중국 휴머노이드 기업들은 완제품보다 상표와 로봇 두뇌 브랜드를 먼저 한국에 들여놓고 있다”며 “국내 휴머노이드 시장이 본격적으로 열리기 전에 중국 기업들이 인증과 이름을 선점하고 있는 만큼, 한국 기업들은 경쟁사이자 잠재 파트너로서 이들의 움직임을 정확히 파악할 필요가 있다”고 말했다. 김명희 기자 noprint@etnews.com

entries.title: Kıyısı olmayan savaş gemisi sokamaz mı? Rusya’ya yakıt satışı iddiası: Karadeniz artık 'savaş riskli' mi? - Son Dakika Haberleri Milliyet
entries.paragraph_2: Zeynep Dilara Akyürek / Milliyet.com.tr – The Guardian gazetesi Karadeniz’de Türkiye’yi de ilgilendiren bir iddia ile yayınladığı haberde, Ukrayna ve Rusya arasındaki gerilim ve Rusya’ya yardım iddiasıyla ‘suçladığı’ Güney Kore ticaretini kaleme aldı. The Guardian’ın kaynak aldığı analiste göre Ukrayna’yı destekleyen çıkarlara ters düşecek hamleler yapan Güney Kore, aynı anda Türkiye’deki NATO zirvesinde ‘Ukrayna’ya yardımlarını ve desteklerini’ dillendiriyordu. Ancak Ukrayna kime ait olduğuna bakmaksızın Karadeniz’de ticaret gemilerini vuruyor, Rusya’ya silahı olmayan insanlar üzerinden saldırıyordu. Tüm bu saldırıların yaşandığı, sivillerin öldüğü ve ticaret gemilerinin battığı Karadeniz artık Montrö’de anlatıldığı ya da vadedildiği gibi güvenli bir alan olmaktan çıkmış mıydı? Aslında tüm bunlar, hatta Türk gemilerine yapılan saldırılara saldırıyla karşılık verilmemesi de Türkiye’yi ve Karadeniz’i koruyan bir güvenlik önlemiydi. Peki nasıl? Deniz Jeopolitiği Danışmanı Deniz Güler, konuyu tüm detaylarıyla Milliyet.com.tr’ye anlattı.

entries.title: The middle-power question that New Delhi faces today | Hindustan Times
entries.paragraph_1: This year has been the year of anxious middle powers. In January, Canadian Prime Minister (PM) Mark Carneytold the World Economic Forum in Davos that the world was going through a rupture rather than a transition, and urged countries like his — essentially, middle powers — to close ranks. On September 21, on the margins of the UN General Assembly, the European Union, Brazil, Canada, Kenya, Australia, Barbados and India launched Partners for Multilateralism (P4M), a platform to defend an order under strain. On October 4, at the Munich Leaders Meeting in Delhi, external affairs minister S Jaishankar spoke about what “emerging and middle powers” might do together. The more the two big powers, or three if you wish, talk to each other warmly but over other States, the more second-rung powers will consult each other. So, expect more middle power talk in the months ahead.
entries.paragraph_2: Where does India stand on the middle power conversation? India’s response to the middle power moment has been ambivalent. New Delhi is both tempted by the idea and resists it.

entries.title: Galaxy S27 Ultra: Samsung Considers Switch to Exynos
entries.paragraph_1: New intel out of South Korea suggests that thermal issues plaguing Qualcomm’s latest Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 is forcing Samsung to consider using an Exynos chipset in the upcoming Galaxy S27 Ultra . If Samsung goes with Exynos, likely the Exynos 2700, this would be the first time we get a non Snapdragon-powered Galaxy flagship since the Galaxy S22 Ultra.
entries.paragraph_2: It’s detailed that both Samsung and Qualcomm are working to resolve the overheating issue, which then leads to throttling by the processor. Internal testing by Samsung forced the company to give Qualcomm a reported deadline of mid-October to fix the issue. The deadline is due to Samsung’s own need to have parts finalized and ready for mass production that would begin before year’s end.
